Interactive versions of material from my teaching: small simulations that run
in your browser, with sliders you can move while they run. They grew out of
Jupyter notebooks for *Theoretical Neuroscience* at Goethe University and a
webinar for the German Neuroscience Olympiad, and are inspired by Dirk
Brockmann's [Complexity Explorables](https://www.complexity-explorables.org/).
